criteria.statement: When the harness manages docker-compose, it verifies Docker daemon availability before invoking docker compose up.
tests: pnpm exec tsx -e helper preflight invocation

criteria.statement: With Docker unavailable, pnpm test:smoke exits before scenario execution with one clear actionable DockerPreflightError and no cleanup failure.
Cleanup for a managed stack is skipped when the stack never started, while successful starts still use the real docker-compose lifecycle.
